capabilities: Highlight selected text in six colours with fill or underline style
Attach multiple editable notes to a single passage
List annotations in a sidebar and jump to them
Search annotations across notes and filter by colour
Export a note's annotations to a new Markdown note
extras: Annotations are stored in the plugin's data.json rather than note Markdown, so that file must be backed up or synced; desktop only, no network requests; includes a Review old highlight cleanup command that backs up the note before removing legacy ==highlight== markers.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to highlight arbitrary text and attach several notes to a passage, then browse, search or export those annotations.
summary: Text annotation plugin that highlights selected passages and attaches multiple notes to each, with sidebar list, search and Markdown export.
